Quick ask as we lock June forecast: can you confirm two things for the Orion AI deal (RDW-2027-3471)?

If easier, respond with short bullets. We have finance close at EOD Friday and need the CRM reconciled before the commit review on Monday.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
